For a sin(x)+b cos(x), coefficient matching and sin²(phi)+cos²(phi)=1 give the positive amplitude R=sqrt(a²+b²), regardless of the stated sine or cosine phase form. Thus q-80131 gives sqrt(16+1)=sqrt(17), q-80126 gives sqrt(7+9)=4, and q-11295 gives sqrt(4+9)=sqrt(13). For q-124641, applying T to (0,0),(1,0),(1,2),(0,2) gives (1,1),(3,2),(1,0),(-1,-1), matching option 2. Its worked solution incorrectly calls the original rectangle a square, but the vertices and image calculation are correct. For q-124343, T(u,v)=(1-v,1+u) maps (0,1),(2,1),(2,2) to (0,1),(0,3),(-1,3), matching option 0. These two image answers agree with the earlier review.
